userStories.title: Create generate-cook-timeline edge function
userStories.description: As a user, I want an AI-generated interleaved cooking timeline that optimizes parallel tasks across multiple recipes.
acceptanceCriteria: supabase/functions/generate-cook-timeline/index.ts exists

Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Follow the patterns from parse-recipe/index.ts: CORS handling (lines 1-20), Supabase client creation with service role key, Anthropic API call with model selection. The AI prompt should say: 'You are a cooking coordinator. Given multiple recipes prepared simultaneously, create an interleaved cooking timeline optimizing parallel tasks. Start with longest tasks (preheating, boiling). Group prep during passive cooking. Tag each step with recipeId and recipeName. Add timing hints. Categorize: prep/active/passive/finish.' Hash recipe IDs with a simple approach: sort IDs, join with comma, use as the hash string (no need for SHA — UUIDs are already unique). Use the model parameter or default to claude-sonnet-4-6.

userStories.title: Create backfill re-parse script
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a one-time script to re-parse all existing recipes with the improved prompt so existing data gets cleaner instructions and ingredients.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/backfill-reparse.ts exists
Queries all recipes with recipe_content.status = 'completed' that have a URL
Calls parse-recipe edge function for each recipe sequentially
Includes a small delay between calls to avoid rate limits
Logs progress (recipe name, success/failure) to console
Skips recipes without a URL (custom meals)
Can be re-run safely (idempotent)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is a Node script run manually (not an edge function). Use the Supabase JS client with the service role key from env vars. Query: supabase.from('recipes').select('id, name, url, recipe_content!inner(status)').eq('recipe_content.status', 'completed').not('url', 'is', null). For each recipe, call supabase.functions.invoke('parse-recipe', { body: { recipeId: recipe.id, url: recipe.url, model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6' } }). Add a 2-second delay between calls. Log: 'Re-parsing [name]... OK/FAILED'. Handle errors per-recipe (don't stop on failure). Usage: npx tsx scripts/backfill-reparse.ts
